backend/main.mo: Primary Motoko canister defining the social chat backend, including user profiles, messaging (DMs and groups), message styling (colors/effects), membership tiers, premium features, storage mixins, access control, Stripe integration, and migration hooks.
backend/migration.mo: Handles state migration from legacy canister types to current types, converting message colors/effects, user profiles, and related data to support new styling options and membership tiers.
feature_evidence.json: Structured report documenting implemented frontend features, mapping feature requirements to files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels for group chat composer styling and plan-based message effects.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of major frontend React files, describing each page, component, hook, and their responsibilities across authentication, chat, feed, profile, music, and creator features.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind and CSS variable definitions using an OKLCH color system, defining light/dark themes, layout tokens, charts, sidebar styles, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React application at the root element and loads the Vite-powered main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component managing authentication flow, loading screens, profile setup gating, and periodic last-online updates before rendering the main app.
frontend/src/components/ChatList.tsx: Sidebar component rendering a list of direct message conversations with avatars, usernames, selection state, and human-readable last-online timestamps.
frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx: Implements a direct chat UI that fetches profiles and messages, polls for updates, auto-scrolls, and tracks last online status. Includes message composition with color/effect styling, though actual DM sending is stubbed with a placeholder toast.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileDialo: Modal dialog for editing the current user's profile bio, wired to an update profile mutation with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/components/FeedItem.tsx: Renders a single feed post showing the user's avatar, username, relative timestamp, and optional status text.
frontend/src/components/FriendSuggestion: Displays a suggested user with avatar and bio and allows the current user to follow them via a mutation.
frontend/src/components/groups/AddGroupM: Dialog component that lets users search profiles and add non-member users to a group, handling loading states and common backend errors with toasts.
frontend/src/components/groups/CreateGro: Dialog for creating a new group with name/description, client-side validation, and optional selection of initial members via profile search.
frontend/src/components/groups/GroupComp: UI picker for selecting message text color and effects, enforcing membership-tier unlock rules and showing upgrade requirements via badges and toasts.
frontend/src/components/groups/GroupConv: Main group chat view that fetches and displays messages, handles sending styled messages, periodic refresh, auto-scroll, and integrates member-adding and style picker dialogs.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Top navigation header showing branding, theme toggle, user points, and a profile dropdown with logout, using identity and profile data.
frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.ts: Full-screen animated loading screen with flame-themed visuals, particle effects, and rhythmic beat animation.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Blocking modal that guides new users through creating a profile with username and bio, calling a create profile mutation.
frontend/src/components/UserCard.tsx: User profile card supporting follow/unfollow actions and starting a new group chat, with navigation to the groups view.
React context that stores and coordinates navigation intent to groups, including a target group ID and optional external navigation handler.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches a backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, initializes access control, and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Authentication context and provider managing Internet Identity login, persisted identities, login state flags, and integration with DFINITY AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Large collection of React Query hooks and temporary types for interacting with the backend actor, covering user profiles, groups, messaging, points, media, search, and other social/app features.
frontend/src/hooks/useStartGroupChat.ts: Provides a mutation hook that creates a new group chat and adds a specified user, then invalidates cached user group queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useVoiceSettings.ts: Manages AI voice settings (enabled, volume, muted) synced with localStorage, supporting same-tab and cross-tab updates via events.
frontend/src/hooks/useWebSearchUltra.ts: Implements a mock web search hook that simulates asynchronous search results with loading and error state management.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS setup and extensive CSS variables for light/dark modes and multiple themed color palettes used across the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that initializes React Query and Internet Identity providers and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AISongGeneratorPage.t: UI page that simulates AI-generated song creation by genre, managing generation state, displaying results, and showing toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/ChatsPage.tsx: Chat interface page that lists direct message partners, supports user search, and renders chat windows with responsive desktop and mobile layouts.
frontend/src/pages/CreatorStudioPage.tsx: Renders a Creator Studio dashboard with a header, tabbed sections (Overview, Music, Videos, Movies, Radio), and summary cards showing counts for different content types.
Implements a daily mystery box page where users can claim a secret reward once per day, showing claim status, animations, and the last claimed item via query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/DailyRewardsPage.tsx: Provides a daily rewards interface allowing users to claim points, view streak-related stats, and see animated feedback based on profile and claim state.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays the home feed with recent status updates, personalized feed items, and friend suggestions, including loading skeletons and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/GamesComingSoonPage.t: Shows a marketing-style 'Games Coming Soon' page with a hero section, feature highlights, and a list of upcoming games fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsPage.tsx: Implements the Groups page where authenticated users can view, create, and select groups, manage initial members, and participate in group conversations using query hooks and dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/HelpPage.tsx: Renders a Help and FAQ page with categorized help sections and expandable accordion items explaining core features, points, premium membership, and common user questions.
frontend/src/pages/LiveStreamsPage.tsx: Displays live and scheduled streams, allows authenticated users to create or stop their own live streams, and lists active broadcasts fetched from backend queries.
frontend/src/pages/LiveTVPage.tsx: Provides a simulated Live TV experience with predefined channels, categories, and a basic play/pause video-style UI for browsing entertainment, news, and music channels.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Shows the public login and marketing page highlighting platform features and branding, and initiates authentication via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/MainApp.tsx: Top-level application shell that manages active page state and renders different feature pages with a navigation menu and header.
frontend/src/pages/MembersOnlyPage.tsx: Premium members area that checks user subscription or free trial status, displays exclusive content, and allows upgrading or activating a trial.
frontend/src/pages/MoviesPage.tsx: Movies browsing page that displays a static list of sample movies with cards and a "Watch Now" action.
frontend/src/pages/MusicPage.tsx: Music library page allowing users to upload tracks, view friends’ music, and play or pause uploaded audio.
frontend/src/pages/PageUnavailablePage.t: Error page shown when content is unavailable, explaining possible causes and offering options to reload or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PhoneProtectionPage.t: Simulated phone security page that runs a mock scan, shows scan progress, and displays basic security status and tips.
frontend/src/pages/PointsPage.tsx: Renders a points wallet page showing the user's current points balance and a sorted transaction history with icons and colors by transaction type. Provides navigation actions to the points store and rewards pages.
frontend/src/pages/PointsStorePage.tsx: Implements a points store where users can buy points or redeem them for store items, with balance checks, quick-buy options, and toast feedback. Fetches store items and user profile data and supports navigation back to the points wallet.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays the user's profile details including avatar, bio, points, followers, rewards stats, and last online status, with loading and error states. Includes an edit profile dialog and derives activity metrics like login streak and rewards claimed.
frontend/src/pages/PublishedAppsPage.tsx: Shows a community gallery of published apps and allows users with sufficient points to publish a new app via a dialog form. Handles validation, point requirements, and publishing feedback with toasts.
frontend/src/pages/RadioPage.tsx: Presents a static list of radio stations with play/stop toggling and simple UI state to indicate the currently playing station. Uses cards and animated indicators without real audio streaming logic.
frontend/src/pages/RobuxSimulatorPage.ts: Implements a playful Robux simulator page that generates fake Robux codes based on a username and amount, with validation, copy-to-clipboard, and toast feedback. The UI clearly warns users that codes are not real and is purely for entertainment.
frontend/src/pages/SearchEnginePage.tsx: A full-featured search engine interface supporting text, voice input, math evaluation, tabbed content types, and optional speech synthesis for results. It integrates multiple hooks for search content, web search, history recording, default engines, and voice settings.
frontend/src/pages/SearchEngineStorePage: Displays a marketplace-style page for browsing available search engines, viewing search history, and setting a default engine when authenticated. Handles loading states, authentication gating, and persistence via query hooks with user feedback.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Provides a simple user search page that queries profiles as the user types and displays results in a responsive grid. Includes loading, empty, and no-results states with a clean search-focused UI.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Manages application audio and AI voice settings, persisting preferences in localStorage and notifying voice listeners on change. Offers toggles and sliders for background music, AI voice enablement, volume, and mute state with toast feedback.
frontend/src/pages/VideosPage.tsx: Implements a mock video upload and listing page where users can add local video files and view them in a simple gallery. Uploads are simulated client-side with temporary URLs and success/error toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/WelcomePage.tsx: Landing page component with branding, feature highlights, and hero image that prompts users to log in via Internet Identity. Renders header, feature grid, call-to-action buttons, and footer.
frontend/src/pages/WhatsNewPage.tsx: Static announcements page displaying recent features and updates using a scrollable card layout. Content is hardcoded markdown-style text presented under a styled header.
frontend/src/pages/WhatsNextPage.tsx: Roadmap page that fetches and displays upcoming features with status icons and badges. Includes loading state, header, roadmap image, and a list of feature cards driven by backend query data.
frontend/src/types/temporary.ts: Temporary TypeScript type definitions for frontend features not yet backed by the backend, including feeds, messages, media, and roadmap items. Defines shared enums like FeatureStatus.
frontend/src/utils/membershipTier.ts: Utility functions for comparing membership tiers and determining unlocked message colors and effects. Maps tiers to display names and required access levels.
frontend/src/utils/messageStyle.ts: Helpers for cycling message colors, mapping colors and effects to labels and Tailwind classes, and rendering lightweight decorations. Includes normalization helpers for backward compatibility.
frontend/src/utils/safeMathEvaluator.ts: Implements a safe arithmetic expression evaluator without eval using tokenization and recursive descent parsing. Supports basic operators, parentheses, unary operators, and error handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities to read URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, persist them in sessionStorage, and retrieve or clear them with URL-first precedence. Includes helpers for safely storing, restoring, and removing sensitive parameters (e.g., admin tokens) without reloading the page.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, content paths, container layout, and extensive theme extensions for colors, radius, shadows, animations, and sidebar/chart tokens. Enables typography, container queries, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: High-level project metadata describing JAMESPaudio, including architecture (React + Motoko on Internet Computer), major features, and a versioned catalog of implemented capabilities. Acts as a structured snapshot of current functionality and system scope for planning and migration.
